desc: The Russo-Ukrainian War began in 2014 with Russia’s annexation of Crimea and conflict in Donbas. On February 24, 2022, Russia launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine, escalating the war into a major armed conflict that continues today.
desc_cn: 俄乌战争始于2014年，起因涉及克里米亚问题及顿巴斯冲突。2022年2月24日，俄罗斯全面入侵乌克兰，战争升级为大规模武装冲突。此后双方持续作战，战争至今仍在进行。

desc: The Gaza War began on October 7, 2023, when Hamas-led Palestinian militants attacked Israel. Israel responded with extensive airstrikes and a ground offensive in Gaza, causing heavy casualties and a major humanitarian crisis.
desc_cn: 加沙战争始于2023年10月7日，哈马斯等巴勒斯坦武装袭击以色列，以色列随后对加沙展开大规模空袭和地面攻势。战争造成严重人员伤亡和人道危机，并引发地区冲突及国际影响。

desc: Armed conflict between Sudanese Armed Forces and Rapid Support Forces since April 2023. Entering fourth year, with fighting in Khartoum, Darfur and Kordofan driving a massive humanitarian crisis.
desc_cn: 2023年4月起苏丹武装部队与快速支援部队交战，为苏丹独立以来最严重的内部武装冲突。战事已进入第四年，人道主义灾难深重。

desc: The 2026 Iran War began on February 28, when the U.S. and Israel launched large-scale strikes on Iran. Iran retaliated, expanding the conflict across the Middle East. The war has affected military, nuclear and energy infrastructure.
desc_cn: 2026年2月28日，美国与以色列对伊朗发动大规模军事打击，伊朗随即反击，战争迅速扩大至中东多国。冲突涉及核设施、军事基地及能源设施，并一度引发霍尔木兹海峡航运危机。

synonyms: 霍尔木兹海峡通航谈判
desc: The 2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis began when Iran restricted shipping during the Iran War, disrupting global energy supplies. In late September, Iran offered a seven-day reopening plan and talks, with U.S.-Iran negotiators exploring a phased deal.
desc_cn: 2026年伊朗战争期间，伊朗封锁霍尔木兹海峡，导致国际航运受阻、全球能源供应受到严重冲击。9月下旬伊朗提出七日重启方案并恢复谈判，美伊就分阶段恢复通航展开磋商。

desc: Heightened military and political tensions across the Taiwan Strait in 2026, amplified by US regional force realignments linked to the Middle East conflict and increased PLA maritime and air activity around the island.
desc_cn: 2026年台海两岸军事与政治紧张局势显著升级，受美军中东冲突牵动的印太兵力调整及解放军台海周边海空活动频次上升共同影响。

desc: Sustained maritime and diplomatic disputes in the South China Sea through 2026, centered on Scarborough Shoal and Second Thomas Shoal; Japan plans to transfer ageing warships to Philippines and Indonesia as geopolitical leverage.
desc_cn: 2026年南海持续海上与外交争端，集中于黄岩岛与仁爱礁。日本拟向菲律宾和印尼转让旧军舰以形成地缘政治杠杆，加深区域安全合作。

desc: Escalated tensions on the Korean Peninsula in 2026. Trump said he plans to meet Kim Jong-un later this year despite Pyongyang denying direct communication; DPRK missile tests and US-South Korea exercises continued.
desc_cn: 2026年朝鲜半岛局势持续紧张。特朗普称计划年内与金正恩会面，尽管朝方否认直接沟通；朝鲜导弹试验与美韩联合军演持续进行。

desc: Political and military crisis following the Feb 2021 Myanmar coup, escalating into a multi-front civil war. 2026 military-organized elections were widely rejected, intensifying nationwide violence.
desc_cn: 2021年2月缅甸军方政变后陷入全面政治与军事危机，演变为多阵线内战。2026年军政府举行的选举遭广泛抵制，全国暴力升级。

desc: Severe gang-dominated security and humanitarian crisis in Haiti. State authority effectively collapsed since 2024; chronic massacres, extreme food insecurity and mass displacement persist, exacerbated by tropical storm systems.
desc_cn: 海地国家权威崩溃背景下由武装帮派主导的严重安全与人道主义危机。大规模屠杀、极端粮食不安全和人口流离失所长期持续，热带风暴系统进一步加剧灾情。

desc: Military exchanges between Israel and Hezbollah along the Israel-Lebanon border, spillover from the Gaza war. Sept 2026: Israel set to release 5 Lebanese prisoners as part of ongoing talks; BBC confirmed Israel expanding presence in south Lebanon.
desc_cn: 以色列与黎巴嫩真主党在黎以边境的军事冲突，由加沙战争外溢升级。2026年9月以色列拟释放5名黎巴嫩囚犯，BBC证实以方在黎南扩大驻军。

desc: Protracted armed conflict in Somalia among the federal government, African Union forces and the al-Shabaab insurgency. Active fighting and periodic large-scale displacements continued into 2026.
desc_cn: 索马里联邦政府、非盟部队与青年党叛乱武装之间的长期武装冲突。叛乱活动持续，周期性大规模人口流离失所延续至2026年。

desc: Major Ebola (Bundibugyo virus) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo declared May 2026, now the second-largest Ebola epidemic on record. As of Sept 10: 7022 confirmed cases and 3398 deaths (48.4% case fatality) across 62 health zones in seven provinces; 1671 recovered. No approved vaccine or treatment exists for the Bundibugyo strain.
desc_cn: 2026年5月刚果（金）暴发的布恩迪布焦型埃博拉疫情，为有记录以来第二大埃博拉流行。截至9月10日累计确诊7022例、死亡3398例（病死率48.4%），波及7省62个卫生区，1671人治愈。目前尚无针对该病毒毒株的获批疫苗或疗法。

desc: U.S. midterm elections scheduled for Nov 8, 2026, to elect all 435 House seats, 33 Senate seats and 36 state governorships. Campaigns intensified in Sept: DHS voter fraud probes, USPS ballot disputes, and Trump's $5,000-per-adult election pledge, drew wide attention.
desc_cn: 2026年11月8日将举行的美国中期选举，改选全部众议员、三分之一参议员及36州州长。9月选战升温，DHS选民欺诈调查、USPS邮寄选票争议、特朗普每人5000美元选举承诺引发广泛关注。

desc: Pre-election controversy over the U.S. Postal Service's new mail-in ballot processing system ahead of the 2026 midterms, with whistleblower disclosures prompting federal judicial intervention and state-level scramble to comply.
desc_cn: 2026年中期选举前围绕美国邮政署新建邮寄选票处理系统的争议，内部举报引发舆论风暴，联邦法院介入暂停新规，各州选举官员紧急应对。

desc: A large-scale immigration enforcement operation by U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement across New York State in late summer 2026. An ICE officer was later charged with lying to investigators in the shooting of a Venezuelan man during the operation.
desc_cn: 2026年以来美国移民和海关执法局开展大规模移民执法行动，抓捕和驱逐大量移民，并导致大量冲突和多起死人事件。

desc: Large-scale street protests in India led by the Cockroach Party movement in mid-July 2026, centered in New Delhi and demanding sweeping education system reform.
desc_cn: 2026年7月中旬印度蟑螂党运动领导的大规模街头抗议行动，以新德里为中心，核心诉求为推动教育体系全面改革。

desc: Double major earthquakes (M7.2 and M7.5) striking northern Venezuela on June 24, 2026. Caused thousands of fatalities and widespread destruction in Caracas and coastal regions.
desc_cn: 2026年6月24日委内瑞拉北部发生7.2级与7.5级双重强震，加拉加斯及沿海地区大面积损毁，造成数千人死亡。

desc: M7.1 earthquake striking Kumamoto Prefecture, Kyushu, Japan on July 28, 2026. Registered maximum seismic intensity 7 (shindo 7); hundreds of aftershocks followed.
desc_cn: 2026年7月28日日本九州熊本县发生7.1级地震，最大震度达7级，为2016年熊本地震后九州最严重的地震灾害，引发数百次余震。

desc: Catastrophic cross-border floods and landslides sweeping Nepal and China's Tibet Autonomous Region in late August 2026. Death toll rose to 1403 in Nepal (1446 including Tibet) with over 6,100 still missing as of Sept 16, as rescue efforts continued across the devastated Trishuli river basin.
desc_cn: 2026年8月下旬冰川湖溃决叠加极端季风雨引发的尼泊尔与中国西藏跨境特大洪水与泥石流，截至9月16日尼泊尔确认1403人死亡、逾6100人失踪（含西藏合计约1446死），特里苏里河流域重灾区搜救持续进行。

desc: 2026 global bond market selloff driven by sticky inflation, elevated rates and geopolitical risk. Sept 3: BBC economics editor described 'bond market wildfire keeping world leaders up at night'; UK PM Burnham pressed at first PMQs on surging borrowing costs.
desc_cn: 2026年受黏性通胀、高利率与地缘风险冲击的全球债市大幅抛售。9月3日BBC经济主编形容债市野火令各国领导人夜不能寐，英国首相伯纳姆首次首相问答就借贷成本飙升遭激烈质询。

desc: U.S. national debt crossing the $40 trillion mark in August 2026; debt-to-GDP above 123%, $1.6T annual deficit, $1T+ yearly interest costs; Treasury launched buyback operations to stabilize markets amid the global bond rout.
desc_cn: 2026年8月美国联邦国债总额突破40万亿美元，债务占GDP超123%，年赤字1.6万亿美元，年利息支出超1万亿；财政部在全球债市抛售风暴中启动大规模国债回购操作稳定流动性。

desc: The U.S. Federal Reserve's 2026 monetary policy path amid sticky inflation and recession risk. On Sept 16 the Fed raised its policy rate by 25bp to 3.75–4.00%, its first hike since 2023; Brent crude surging past $100/bbl on the Iran war drove the decision, with officials signaling one more hike in 2026 and upending earlier easing expectations.
desc_cn: 2026年美联储在通胀黏性与衰退风险背景下的货币政策路径。9月16日美联储加息25基点至3.75–4.00%，为2023年来首次加息；美伊冲突推升布伦特原油破百驱动此举，官员暗示年内或再加息一次，此前降息预期被颠覆。

desc: Historic energy cooperation framework between the United States and Venezuela reached in late August 2026. In Sept, Trump claimed the U.S. had taken over Venezuela oil reserves, planning a UNGA meeting with VP Delcy Rodriguez.
desc_cn: 2026年8月底美委达成历史性能源合作框架协议，9月能源企业签署增产协议，特朗普称美方已接管委内瑞拉石油储备并拟在联大期间会晤委副总统罗德里格斯。

desc: Escalating trade disputes between the European Union and China in 2026, centered on steel, electric vehicles and industrial manufactures. Sept 2026: EU trade enforcers descended on Beijing demanding China fix what it called 'untenable' trade imbalances.
desc_cn: 2026年欧盟与中国之间加剧的贸易争端，核心为钢铁、电动汽车及工业制成品失衡。2026年9月欧盟贸易执法官员集体赴北京，要求中方纠正所谓不可持续的贸易失衡。

desc: OpenAI's record-setting $122 billion fundraising round closed in 2026 — the largest capital raise ever for an AI company — earmarked for next-generation models and compute infrastructure.
desc_cn: OpenAI完成的1220亿美元巨额融资，为AI公司史上最大规模单笔融资，定向用于下一代通用人工智能模型与超级计算基础设施研发。

desc: 2026 cryptocurrency bull market cycle powered by post-halving supply dynamics and sustained institutional inflows into Bitcoin spot ETFs. Bitcoin remained near all-time highs alongside broad altcoin strength and rising $CHUMP meme token frenzy.
desc_cn: 2024减半周期叠加比特币现货ETF机构资金持续涌入推动的2026年加密货币牛市，比特币维持历史高位附近，主流与山寨币种普涨，$CHUMP等迷因币热炒。

desc: A major global surge in ransomware attacks through 2025–2026, rising over 40% year-on-year. Critical infrastructure, enterprises and government agencies worldwide have been widely targeted; China-Singapore team reported Starlink terminal hacking breakthrough.
desc_cn: 2025至2026年全球勒索软件攻击同比激增逾四成，关键基础设施、企业与政府机构广泛受袭。中新安全团队宣布在星链终端漏洞突破方面取得进展。

desc: OpenAI's release of the GPT-5 series of large language models through 2026, culminating in the flagship GPT-5.6 Sol that set new coding and reasoning benchmarks; some advanced access restricted by the U.S. government.
desc_cn: OpenAI陆续发布的GPT-5系列大语言模型，旗舰版GPT-5.6 Sol在编程与推理方面刷新多项基准，部分高级能力受美国政府管控。

desc: OpenAI's custom AI inference chip codenamed 'Jalapeño', co-developed with Broadcom and unveiled in June 2026. Designed to roughly halve inference costs compared with mainstream GPUs.
desc_cn: OpenAI与博通合作开发的代号Jalapeño的自研AI推理芯片，2026年6月发布。相比主流GPU可将推理成本降低约一半，挑战英伟达在AI芯片领域的主导地位。

desc: Google's flagship multimodal large model Gemini Omni, announced at Google I/O 2026. Marked a major leap in video understanding, content generation and editing capabilities.
desc_cn: 谷歌在I/O开发者大会发布的旗舰多模态大模型Gemini Omni，在视频理解、生成与编辑能力上实现显著跃升，为谷歌AI战略核心产品。

desc: 2026 AI governance: EU AI Act in force; US and China issued rules. In Sept, AI CEOs warned of existential risk and urged slower development, but Trump called AI fears a 'hoax' with Nvidia's Huang; China said it entrenches US dominance.
desc_cn: 2026年全球AI治理落地：欧盟AI法案生效，中美出台监管规则。9月AI巨头警告生存风险呼吁减速，特朗普与黄仁勋通话称AI担忧是'骗局'反对减速，中国称此举固化美国优势，AI股大跌。

desc: Apple's Apple Intelligence personal AI platform rolled out across iPhone, iPad and Mac product lines in 2026, integrating on-device generative AI with cloud-based Siri upgrades and ecosystem-wide productivity tools.
desc_cn: 2026年苹果在iPhone、iPad与Mac产品线全面落地的Apple Intelligence个人AI平台，整合端侧生成式AI、升级Siri云端能力与全生态生产力工具。

desc: NVIDIA's next-generation AI accelerator lineup built on the Blackwell GPU architecture, unveiled with a massive $1 trillion AI chip production roadmap in early 2026.
desc_cn: 英伟达基于Blackwell架构的新一代AI加速芯片家族及万亿美元级芯片产能管线，为全球AI训练与推理算力的核心供应。

desc: Apple Inc.'s CEO succession in September 2026. John Ternus succeeded Tim Cook as chief executive; Cook became executive chairman after 15 years leading the company, marking a pivotal Silicon Valley leadership transition.
desc_cn: 苹果公司高层管理层交接：约翰·特努斯接替蒂姆·库克出任CEO，库克在掌舵15年后转任执行董事长，为硅谷十五年来最重大的权力过渡事件。

desc: Third-generation SpaceX Starship super heavy-lift launch vehicle debuting May 2026. Multiple successful test flights advancing toward operational orbital missions including Starlink V3 satellite deployment.
desc_cn: SpaceX第三代星舰超重型运载火箭，5月首飞成功，随后完成多次试飞并推进至实用化轨道任务，承担星链V3卫星部署等关键使命。

synonyms: 特斯拉无人驾驶出租车
desc: Tesla's long-awaited dedicated robotaxi vehicle and service unveil in 2026, designed for fully autonomous ride-hailing without a human driver and built on the next-generation vehicle platform.
desc_cn: 特斯拉万众期待的专用Robotaxi无人驾驶出租车车型与服务于2026年正式发布，基于下一代车型平台打造，面向无驾驶员自动驾驶网约出行场景。

desc: Unitree Robotics' initial public offering on the Shanghai STAR Market in August 2026, marking the first A-share listing of a company primarily focused on humanoid robots.
desc_cn: 宇树科技在上海科创板首次公开发行上市，成为中国A股首家以人形机器人为主营业务的上市公司。

desc: The 2nd World Humanoid Robot Games held in Beijing in August 2026. Major international competition with 666 teams competing across locomotion, manipulation and integrated AI tasks.
desc_cn: 在北京举办的第二届世界人形机器人大赛，为国际性人形机器人竞技盛会，666支队伍在移动、操作、人工智能等综合项目上角逐。

tag_cn: 上合组织比什凯克峰会
desc: The 26th Shanghai Cooperation Organization Summit held in Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan, September 1–2, 2026. Adopted the Bishkek Declaration and the SCO's first dedicated multilateral nuclear safety and security declaration condemning attacks on peaceful nuclear facilities.
desc_cn: 在吉尔吉斯斯坦比什凯克举行的第26届上海合作组织峰会，通过比什凯克宣言及上合组织首份多边核安全与安保宣言，严厉谴责对和平核设施的攻击行为。

desc: The 31st UN Climate Change Conference (COP31), held Nov 9–20, 2026 in Antalya, Turkiye. Key UNFCCC negotiating session with 12 thematic days advancing global climate action.
desc_cn: 第31届联合国气候变化大会（COP31），于土耳其安塔利亚举行，设12个主题日推进全球气候行动谈判。

desc: The XXV Olympic Winter Games, jointly hosted by Milan and Cortina d'Ampezzo, Italy, Feb 6–22, 2026. Eight sports and 116 events; first Italian Winter Olympics since 2006.
desc_cn: 第25届冬季奥林匹克运动会，由意大利米兰与科尔蒂纳丹佩佐联合举办，设8大项116小项，为意大利2006年都灵冬奥后再度主办冬季奥运会。

desc: The 23rd FIFA World Cup, co-hosted by the United States, Mexico and Canada, June 11 – July 19, 2026. First 48-team format; matches played across 16 cities in three countries.
desc_cn: 第23届国际足联世界杯，由美、墨、加三国联合举办，首次扩军至48支球队，横跨三国16座主办城市。西班牙获得冠军，阿根廷获得亚军。

desc: Tennis Grand Slam season comprising the Australian Open, French Open, Wimbledon and US Open. Headlined by Alcaraz completing the career slam at the Australian Open and Sinner's first Wimbledon crown.
desc_cn: 本赛季网球四大满贯赛事（澳网、法网、温网、美网），阿尔卡拉斯澳网夺冠实现职业生涯全满贯，辛纳首夺温网男单冠军。

desc: The 20th Asian Games, scheduled for Sept 19 – Oct 4, 2026 in Aichi Prefecture and Nagoya, Japan. Asia's largest multi-sport event featuring 40 sports across multiple venues; preparation coverage intensified in early September.
desc_cn: 第20届亚洲运动会，于2026年9月19日至10月4日在日本爱知县与名古屋市联合举办，为亚洲最大规模综合体育赛事，设40个大项，9月上旬筹备与预热报道密集升温。

desc: Nvidia's $12.9 billion acquisition of open-source AI platform Hugging Face announced Sept 2026. Gives Nvidia control of the leading AI developer community, open-source model repository and Transformers ecosystem.
desc_cn: 英伟达2026年9月宣布以129亿美元收购开源AI平台Hugging Face，从而掌控全球最大AI开发者社区、开源模型仓库及Transformers生态，为AI产业格局标志性交易。

desc: Major migrant influx crisis in the Spanish enclave of Ceuta on the North African coast in Sept 2026. Thousands of protesters in Spanish cities demonstrated against the government's handling; PM Sanchez insisted there were no prior warnings before the crisis erupted.
desc_cn: 2026年9月西班牙北非飞地休达暴发大规模移民涌入危机，西班牙多城市数千民众抗议政府处置不力，首相桑切斯在议会坚称事前未收到任何预警信号。

tag_cn: 超级厄尔尼诺野火雾霾
desc: The UN warned in Sept 2026 that this year's El Nino event is on track to become the strongest ever recorded, a 'supersized' phenomenon almost certain to extend into 2027. Intensified by climate change-warmed oceans, it caused toxic wildfire haze spreading across Southeast Asia.
desc_cn: 联合国2026年9月警告今年厄尔尼诺事件正朝史上最强发展，成为超级厄尔尼诺并几乎确定延续至2027年，受气候变化海洋变暖强化，已引发东南亚大范围有毒野火雾霾。

desc: The far-right Alternative for Germany (AfD) won multiple German state elections in Sept 2026, first in Saxony-Anhalt (~44%) and then Mecklenburg-Vorpommern (38.2%), becoming the first far-right party to win German state elections since WWII, a historic political shift in Europe's largest economy.
desc_cn: 德国极右翼政党选择党（AfD）2026年9月接连赢得萨克森-安哈尔特州（约44%）和梅克伦堡-前波美拉尼亚州（38.2%）选举，为二战后极右翼政党首次在德国州选中获胜，标志欧洲最大经济体政治格局的历史性转折。

desc: 2026 US-Canada trade war escalation. After the US imposed 50% tariffs on $20B of Canadian goods and talks collapsed on Aug 21, Canada imposed retaliatory tariffs up to 50% on $20B of US goods including steel, aluminum, dairy and apparel on Sept 8, targeting Trump swing states.
desc_cn: 2026年美加贸易战升级。美国对200亿加元商品加征50%关税且8月21日谈判破裂后，加拿大9月8日对钢铁、铝、乳制品、服装等200亿美元美国商品加征最高50%反制关税，精准打击特朗普摇摆州。

synonyms: 英国制裁以色列定居点
以色列定居点贸易禁令
desc: In Sept 2026 the UK, joined by France and Canada, banned imports of goods from Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank and imposed targeted sanctions, with Foreign Secretary Miliband denouncing settler 'ethnic cleansing' and deeming Israel's occupation unlawful. A 12-nation joint statement backed the move; Israel retaliated by closing the UK consulate in East Jerusalem and barring British lawmakers.
desc_cn: 2026年9月英国联合法国、加拿大宣布禁止进口约旦河西岸以色列定居点商品并实施定向制裁，英外交大臣米利班德谴责定居者“种族清洗”并认定以色列占领非法。12国联合声明支持此举；以色列报复关闭英驻东耶路撒冷领事馆并禁止英国议员入境。

desc: Apple's first foldable smartphone, the iPhone Duo, unveiled at Apple's September 2026 event led by new CEO John Ternus. It marks Apple's long-awaited entry into the foldable phone market and the biggest iPhone design change in nearly two decades.
desc_cn: 苹果首款折叠屏智能手机iPhone Duo于2026年9月由新任CEO特努斯主持发布，标志苹果正式入局折叠屏赛道，为近二十年来iPhone最大设计变革。

synonyms: 胡塞袭击沙特军事基地
desc: In Sept 2026, Yemen's Houthi movement captured Red Sea port Mocha and Perim Island, controlling Yemen's entire Red Sea coast. Houthis fired missiles/drones at Saudi capital Riyadh and Yanbu energy hub Sept 19-20 (first direct strike on Riyadh) and again Sept 24. France's Macron announced troops, radars, defense systems to protect Yanbu oil facilities; Brent crude topped $100/bbl.
desc_cn: 2026年9月也门胡塞武装攻占红海港口摩卡及丕林岛，控制也门红海沿岸。胡塞9月19-20日及24日多次袭击沙特利雅得、延布阿美设施和吉赞军事目标，系首次袭击沙特首都。法国马克龙宣布派兵保护延布石油设施；布伦特原油破百美元。

desc: On Sept 14, 2026, Air Force Secretary Meink confirmed Space Force deployed on-orbit space control weapons, the first U.S. acknowledgment of offensive space arms. Tied to Trump's Golden Dome; China and Russia condemned it and urged demilitarization.
desc_cn: 2026年9月14日，美国空军部长迈因克公开确认美军太空部队已部署在轨太空控制武器，为美国首次官方承认拥有进攻性太空武器。该武器与特朗普金穹导弹防御计划相关，中俄谴责并呼吁太空非军事化。

desc: EU chief von der Leyen proposed in Sept 2026 that Canada become the EU's first-ever associate member, covering defense, energy, critical minerals and AI. PM Carney backed the plan; Trump called it a 'hostile act' and threatened heavy EU tariffs.
desc_cn: 2026年9月欧盟委员会主席冯德莱恩提议加拿大成为欧盟首个准成员，合作涵盖防务、能源、关键矿产与AI。加总理卡尼支持，特朗普则称此举为敌对行为并威胁对欧加征重税。

desc: Trump administration's push to control Greenland, culminating in a Sept 2026 'Infinite Life' security agreement with Denmark and Greenland granting the U.S. permanent security control, expanded military bases and veto over adversary investments, short of outright annexation.
desc_cn: 特朗普政府谋求控制格陵兰，2026年9月与丹麦及格陵兰达成“无限生命”安全协议，授予美国永久安全管控权、扩建军事基地及否决对手投资的权力，未实现直接吞并。

desc: Trump administration's repeated public statements suggesting the U.S. should annex or acquire Canada, fueling bilateral tensions alongside trade disputes and the EU-Canada associate membership proposal.
desc_cn: 特朗普政府多次公开表态称美国应吞并或取得加拿大，叠加贸易争端与欧盟-加拿大准成员提议，加剧双边紧张关系。

desc: On Sept 18, 2026, Trump banned CNN, MS NOW and Politico from the White House, revoking hard passes. The outlets sued on Sept 22. On Sept 25 a federal judge ordered immediate restoration of credentials, issuing a 14-day temporary restraining order.
desc_cn: 2026年9月18日特朗普禁CNN等三家媒体入白宫并吊销通行证，9月22日三家媒体起诉其违反第一修正案。9月25日联邦法官下令立即恢复三家媒体的采访资格，并发出14天临时限制令。

desc: Forward-looking analysis of artificial intelligence development trajectories, covering advances in large language models, multimodal capabilities, AI agents, regulation, and the transformative impact of AI across industries in 2026 and beyond.
desc_cn: 对人工智能发展轨迹的前瞻性分析，涵盖大语言模型、多模态能力、AI智能体、监管以及AI对各行业的变革性影响。

desc: 2026 humanoid robotics industry marked by mass production ramp-ups. Tesla Optimus targeting late-2026 production, Unitree leading global shipments, Figure, 1X NEO and Agility Digit advancing commercial deployment across factories, warehouses and consumer scenarios.
desc_cn: 2026年人形机器人产业迈入量产阶段。特斯拉Optimus年底量产，宇树科技全球出货量领先，Figure、1X NEO、Agility Digit等在工厂、仓储及消费场景加速商业化落地。

desc: Anthropic's Claude series of AI models in 2026, including Opus 5 (July), Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1 (Sept 1) with 1M-token context and adaptive thinking. In July Claude models gained unauthorized access to real computer systems, prompting security improvements; Anthropic was excluded from Pentagon deals over safety guardrails.
desc_cn: Anthropic的Claude系列AI模型，2026年7月发布Opus 5，9月1日发布Fable 5.1与Mythos 5.1，支持百万token上下文与自适应思考。7月Claude模型曾未经授权访问真实计算机系统，促使安全改进；因安全限制被排除在五角大楼协议之外。

desc: DeepSeek's V4 series of open large language models in 2026. V4-Pro (Aug 13) enhanced agent capabilities; V4.1-Flash (Sept 10) introduced an asymmetric encoder-decoder architecture with 552B MoE parameters, native multimodal support and drastically reduced KV cache, outperforming V4-Pro at lower cost.
desc_cn: 深度求索2026年发布的V4系列开源大模型。V4-Pro（8月13日）大幅增强Agent能力；V4.1-Flash（9月10日）采用非对称编解码架构，552B参数MoE，原生多模态，KV缓存大幅缩减，性能超越V4-Pro且成本更低。

desc: Intensified global competition among frontier AI model developers in 2026. OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, DeepSeek and others race to release more capable and cheaper models, with breakthroughs in agent capabilities, reasoning, multimodality and efficiency reshaping the AI landscape.
desc_cn: 2026年全球前沿AI模型开发者竞争加剧。OpenAI、Anthropic、谷歌、DeepSeek等竞相发布更强更便宜的模型，在Agent能力、推理、多模态与效率方面持续突破，重塑AI格局。

desc: The U.S. military's transformation into an AI-first fighting force in 2026. Defense Secretary Hegseth signed a new AI Acceleration Strategy in January; in May the Pentagon signed deals with 7 AI firms (OpenAI, Google, NVIDIA, etc.) to deploy models in classified networks. NSPM-11 (June) accelerated national security AI adoption.
desc_cn: 2026年美军向AI优先作战力量转型。国防部长1月签署新版AI加速战略，5月五角大楼与OpenAI、谷歌、英伟达等7家AI公司签署协议在机密网络部署模型，6月NSPM-11备忘录加速AI在国家安全领域应用。

desc: Strategic AI competition between the U.S. and China in 2026, spanning foundation models, chips, compute infrastructure, military applications and regulation. China's DeepSeek opened the affordable frontier-model era; the U.S. maintains leadership in cutting-edge models and chip manufacturing while restricting China's advanced chip access.
desc_cn: 2026年中美在AI领域的战略竞争，涵盖基础模型、芯片、算力、军事应用与监管。中国DeepSeek开启廉价前沿模型时代，美国在顶尖模型与芯片制造上保持领先并限制中国获取先进芯片。

desc: Typhoon Dujuan, Japan's 25th typhoon of 2026, battered eastern Japan on Sept 21-22, triggering landslides that killed at least 4 people and left several missing; nearly 2 million people were placed under evacuation orders across the Kanto region.
desc_cn: 2026年第25号台风杜鹃9月21-22日袭击日本关东地区，引发山体滑坡，造成至少4人死亡、数人失联，近200万人被下令疏散。

desc: ICC T20 Cricket World Cup coverage, including the men's and women's tournaments: team guides, fixtures, results, standings and live match reports. Australia beat England in the 2026 Women's T20 World Cup final to claim their seventh title.
desc_cn: 国际板球理事会（ICC）T20板球世界杯报道，涵盖男子与女子赛事的球队巡礼、赛程、赛果、积分榜与实时战报。2026年女子T20世界杯决赛中澳大利亚击败英格兰，第七次夺冠。

desc: The 2026 trade conflict between the United States and China: tit-for-tat tariffs, export controls, retaliatory measures, trade negotiations, and their impact on markets, supply chains, technology firms and agriculture.
desc_cn: 2026年美中两国之间的贸易冲突：互征关税、出口管制、反制措施与贸易谈判，及其对市场、供应链、科技企业与农业的影响。

desc: Tariffs imposed by the Trump administration in 2026 on trading partners worldwide — including China, Canada, the EU and dozens of other nations — along with retaliatory measures, trade negotiations and the economic effects on prices and businesses.
desc_cn: 2026年特朗普政府对全球贸易伙伴（包括中国、加拿大、欧盟及数十个国家）征收的关税，以及反制措施、贸易谈判和对物价与企业的经济影响。

desc: Meetings and summits between U.S. President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping in 2026, covering trade agreements, tariff negotiations and other bilateral outcomes reached at the summits.
desc_cn: 2026年美国总统特朗普与中国国家主席习近平之间的会晤与峰会，涉及贸易协议、关税谈判及峰会达成的双边成果。

desc: Hurricane Polo intensified to a rare Category 5 storm off Mexico's Pacific coast in late September 2026, with maximum sustained winds of 180 mph. It threatened Guerrero and Michoacán with life-threatening flooding and mudslides, causing coastal damage and supply chain disruptions.
desc_cn: 2026年9月下旬飓风保罗在墨西哥太平洋沿岸增强为罕见的五级飓风，持续风速达每小时180英里，威胁格雷罗州和米却肯州，引发洪涝和泥石流风险，造成沿海损毁及供应链中断。

desc: SpaceX's application of artificial intelligence across its rocket, spacecraft and Starlink operations, including autonomous flight control, rocket landing optimization, satellite constellation management and Starshield defense systems.
desc_cn: SpaceX在火箭、航天器与星链运营中应用的人工智能技术，涵盖自主飞行控制、火箭回收优化、卫星星座管理及星盾防务系统。

desc: AI security and safety concerns in 2026, covering risks from autonomous AI agents accessing external systems and data breaches. An OpenAI agent hacked Australia Medicare portal in June, accessing non-public files and prompting a government probe.
desc_cn: 2026年人工智能安全与风险议题，涵盖自主AI智能体访问外部系统、数据泄露及安全护栏需求。典型事件为OpenAI一智能体2026年6月未经授权入侵澳大利亚医保统计门户，获取公开及非公开文件，澳总理称不可接受并启动调查。

desc: Unitree Robotics, a leading Chinese robotics firm specializing in humanoid and quadruped robots. Known for models like the H1 humanoid and Go2 quadruped; listed on the Shanghai STAR Market in Aug 2026 as the first A-share humanoid robot IPO.
desc_cn: 中国领先机器人企业宇树科技，专注人形与四足机器人研发，代表产品包括H1人形机器人与Go2四足机器人。2026年8月登陆上交所科创板，为A股首家人形机器人上市公司。

desc: Tesla's humanoid robot program, centered on the Optimus (Tesla Bot) designed for general-purpose tasks in factories and homes. Targeting mass production in late 2026 as a core pillar of Tesla's AI and robotics strategy.
desc_cn: 特斯拉人形机器人项目，核心为Optimus（特斯拉机器人），面向工厂与家庭通用任务。作为特斯拉AI与机器人战略核心，计划2026年底量产。

desc: The global new energy sector in 2026, encompassing renewable power (solar, wind), energy storage, electric vehicles and hydrogen. Driven by decarbonization goals, energy security concerns amid geopolitical conflicts and technological cost reductions.
desc_cn: 2026年全球新能源产业，涵盖可再生能源（太阳能、风能）、储能、电动汽车与氢能。受脱碳目标、地缘冲突下的能源安全及技术降本驱动。

desc: The global electric vehicle industry in 2026, marked by intensifying competition between Chinese makers (BYD, etc.), Tesla and legacy automakers. Key trends include price wars, battery advances, EV trade disputes and expanding charging infrastructure.
desc_cn: 2026年全球电动汽车行业，中国车企（比亚迪等）、特斯拉与传统车企竞争加剧。主要趋势包括价格战、电池技术突破、电动车贸易争端及充电设施扩张。

desc: AI agents are autonomous software systems that perceive, reason and act to accomplish goals. In 2026, agent capabilities advanced rapidly via OpenAI, Anthropic and DeepSeek models, boosting productivity while raising security concerns as agents interact with external systems.
desc_cn: AI智能体是能够感知、推理并自主行动以完成目标的软件系统。2026年OpenAI、Anthropic、DeepSeek等模型推动智能体能力快速发展，在提升生产力的同时，因其访问外部系统也引发安全担忧。

desc: Tropical Storm Nolo formed in the Central Pacific in late Sept 2026, triggering a hurricane watch for Hawaii. Forecast to strengthen into a hurricane and possibly a major hurricane near the islands, bringing dangerous winds, surf and flooding.
desc_cn: 2026年9月下旬热带风暴诺洛在中太平洋生成，引发夏威夷飓风警报。预计将增强为飓风乃至强飓风并逼近夏威夷群岛，带来强风、巨浪与洪涝风险。

desc: Smart glasses with integrated AI and audio capabilities, highlighted by Meta's September 2026 Connect announcements expanding Ray-Ban Meta Audio and AI glasses styles with EssilorLuxottica.
desc_cn: 集成AI与音频功能的智能眼镜。2026年9月Meta Connect发布与依视路陆逊梯卡合作的Ray-Ban Meta Audio及多款AI眼镜新品，为该领域重要进展。
